description: POV: You Wake Up As A ___

description: Eating bread and beer for breakfast, sitting up on the mat

description: Walking out through the workers' village toward the pyramid at sunrise

description: Arriving at the base of the pyramid where a limestone block sits roped to a wooden sledge

description: Hauling the limestone block on ropes alongside a team, straining against the weight

label: Shaping Stone
description: Chiseling and shaping a limestone block with a copper chisel and wooden mallet

description: A clay water jug passed hand to hand, drinking during a short break

label: Midday Meal
description: Eating bread, dried fish, and onions in the shade of a rock overhang with other workers

label: Levering
description: Levering a stone block up an earthen construction ramp with wooden poles

description: A scribe marking rations and labor counts on a papyrus scroll nearby

label: Walk Home
description: Walking home at dusk, exhausted, the half-built pyramid silhouetted behind

label: Rest
description: Lying back down on the reed mat at day's end, the pyramid visible through the doorway in moonlight
